tools.name: browser.navigate
tools.description: Navigate an explicit CDP browser tab to a URL.

sandbox.reason: Browser navigation can disclose network activity and is policy-gated.

tools.name: browser.inspect
tools.description: Read page title, URL, visible text, and link/form summaries from an explicit CDP browser tab.

sandbox.reason: Page inspection reads only the explicit browser target.

tools.name: browser.click
tools.description: Click a selector in an explicit CDP browser tab.

sandbox.reason: Browser interaction can trigger external actions and is policy-gated.

tools.name: browser.type
tools.description: Type text into a selector in an explicit CDP browser tab.

sandbox.reason: Browser typing can enter private data and is policy-gated.

tools.name: browser.screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot from an explicit CDP browser tab as base64 PNG or to an output path.

sandbox.reason: Screenshot capture can reveal private page state and is policy-gated.

tools.name: browser.submit_form
tools.description: Submit a selector-backed form in an explicit CDP browser tab.

sandbox.reason: Form submission can perform external actions and requires approval.
